actions_taken: Implemented a local JSON-RPC-over-HTTP MCP endpoint for order_reading and tasks/get.
Implemented a -32042 payment-required response with data.httpStatus=402 and an MPP Stripe charge challenge.
Implemented SQLite reservation and finalization transactions with database uniqueness, request fingerprinting, and durable task/receipt binding.
Implemented direct Stripe test-mode PaymentIntent creation+confirmation with a deterministic server-side Stripe idempotency key.
Stored the byte-exact HTTP 200 JSON-RPC success and returned it on replay without another Stripe request.
Implemented buyer persistence for receipt, taskId, logical-purchase idempotency key, and payer material.
Selected and documented a 256-bit transferable bearer taskId claim-security model.
Created and confirmed one live Stripe test-mode USD 150 PaymentIntent and committed redacted trace evidence.
key_results: Live Stripe test PaymentIntent pi_3U9apjJLQJGtDcdp1soLay0Z reached status=succeeded for USD 150.00.
The paid success and replay both returned HTTP 200 and the same raw-response SHA-256 6f21e3b4b8e6308290232ee5c58e461f25e74e8620ff36ab7b3b5b0e1d48139e.
The live seller made one Stripe request and stored exactly one order, PaymentIntent reference, task, and receipt.
A fresh tasks/get resolved the returned taskId before success and preserved the same receipt.
Reusing an idempotency key with a different request fingerprint returns JSON-RPC error -32043 without calling Stripe.
All P1-P3 tests pass; only the intentionally unimplemented P4 cold-restart contract remains red in the full suite.

assumptions_made.assumption: A 256-bit opaque taskId is a transferable bearer claim and possession authorizes tasks/get.
assumptions_made.invalidation_condition: A ratified MPP/MCP Tasks composition rule requires proof-of-possession or non-transferable payer binding.

assumptions_made.assumption: The Stripe test payment method pm_card_visa is suitable payer material for this isolated server-side test flow.
assumptions_made.invalidation_condition: Stripe removes or changes the server-side test PaymentMethod behavior used by PaymentIntent confirmation.

scope_creep_surfaced: No production key, customer, live payment, webhook, refund, or dispute lifecycle was used or implemented.
No process was killed and no cold restart was attempted; that is P4.
The committed live trace hashes the bearer taskId and raw response instead of publishing the capability token.
The local buyer SQLite store is not encrypted; this is an explicit limitation of the isolated test fixture.
next_phase_readiness_reason: The direct paid flow, durable replay, tasks/get resolution, buyer persistence, and claim model are complete. P4 can test process death and cold resume only after the literal token go.
